newsitem.title: THAILAND: Asia Fiber to issue new shares, warrants.
newsitem.headline: Asia Fiber to issue new shares, warrants.

text.p: Thai petrochemcial firm, Asia Fiber Plc, said on Friday the company will raise its registered capital to 706.8 million baht ($28.27 million) from 372 million by issuing 33.48 million new shares.
Of the new shares, 18.6 million shares will be offered to existing sharesholders through a 2-for-1 rights issue at 10 baht each, Asia Fiber said in a filing to the Stock Exchange of Thailand.
The remaining shares will be reserved for the exercise of its planned warrants, the company said.
Asia Fiber said it also plans to issue 14.88 million warrants to its shareholders for free at the ratio of five old shares to two new warrants.
The proceeds will be used to repay the company's existing debts in order to reduce interest expenses, it said.
